aifc.scientific_domain: independent future-event admission and provenance, NOT SAT computation

theorem.factorization: F is a conjunction of independent connected components F_i of the variable-clause incidence graph; global SAT iff SAT(F_i) for all i
theorem.exact_composition: Global SAT witness is the disjoint union of local witnesses; one UNSAT local certificate suffices for global UNSAT
theorem.local_approach: Necessary XOR relaxation, complete verification of 2^k_i affine candidates against original signed Exact-One clauses
theorem.tractable_class: Any family with uniformly bounded local XOR nullity k_i, even if global nullity sum_i k_i and primal width are unbounded
theorem.structural_limitation: No claimed general solution for irreducible connected high-width/high-nullity instances
theorem.novelty_boundary: Known independent-factor CSP decomposition, not a novel P vs NP theorem

actual_tests.aifc_domain_hashes: JANUS:EXACTONE:COMPONENT_PRODUCT:v1; source-bound hashes are not a cryptographic witness quorum

aifc_further_integration.target: AURA Oracle / CHRONOS future random target experiments
aifc_further_integration.connection: AURA Fortune Cookie can provide a sealed precommitment but AIFC additionally requires externally certified trial creation before candidate production, independent witness quorum, post-freeze entropy proof, multiplicity audit, and verified causal and statistical gates
aifc_further_integration.statement: Physical retrocausality not observed or proven

open_barrier: Polynomial discovery, compact exact representation, composition and witness reconstruction for arbitrary connected irreducible Exact-One with both growing primal width and growing XOR nullity
